title: Postdoc in Cognitive Computational Neuroscience and Human Movement Perception
institution: University of Copenhagen, Department of Psychology
about: 30-month fixed-term postdoc in the Independent Research Fund Denmark project 'Mapping Experience of Action: Redefining Theories of Consciousness', led by Thor Grünbaum and Mark Schram Christensen. Combines psychophysical experiments, computational modelling and philosophical analysis of conscious movement experience. Start 1 March 2027.
requirements: Background in e.g. cognitive (neuro)science, computational neuroscience, cognitive modelling, biomedical engineering or sports science with a behavioural neuroscience focus
Short project description fitting the wider project

upskill.name: Machine Learning & Predictive Modelling I
why: 'Background in e.g. ... computational neuroscience, cognitive modelling' → 'Compare predictive approaches according to the structure of the data, the analytical objective, and the assumptions of the modelling method.'

'computational modelling' (project description) → 'Build supervised learning models for regression and classification using methods such as support vector machines, random forests, and gradient boosting.'
